'''E'Sar G'Go B'Kul''' was the leader of the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] resistance group [[T'B'Dellyi'Mai]]. Young, arrogant and aggressive, he had a innate talent for devising insurrection and terrorist tactics. E'Sar G'Go B'Kul hated all offworlders.
